data.content_ref: inline:ABSTRACTS: The 024cbd0e1e4f census delta abstracts a latent invariant violation in the verification instrument layer: the principle that every instrument counting failures (sweep, direct-load, verify_root_report) must agree on the ERROR vs verdict partition for any given root. SRC_002, SRC_004, and SRC_005 each treat the 3-root delta as a specific bug to be tested, but the abstraction is that the verification layer lacks a shared classification contract — there is no canonical mapping from root state to (ERROR | verdict) that all instruments reference, so each instrument implements its own classification logic and they diverge on boundary cases (pre-v6 roots). The 024cbd0e1e4f gap is one instance of this missing-contract abstraction. This is REFUTED IF the instruments do share a single classification function or lookup table and the delta arises from a call-site bug (wrong arguments) rather than a missing contract — the divergence would then be a local error, not an abstraction-level invariant violation.
